rationale: Phase 1 smoke (147 candidates over 14 shapes) found only 5 candidates across 2 shapes that beat current by +3% with fin>=0.98 & wcf<0.02 (1-rep). Phase 2 5-run consensus then disqualified all 5 under the strict +5%/n_OK>=4 gate: the best n_OK=5 candidate yielded only +1.7%; the best delta (+4.2%) only had n_OK=2/5. The existing R40B/R41A/R41B variant table is at-or-near optimal for these 14 shapes within the (FINITE_GATE=0.98, no-new-macro) constraint.
